using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Library;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Providers;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.Tests
{
    public class VideoTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILibraryManager> _mockLibraryManager;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<Video>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Video _video;

        public VideoTests()
        {
            _mockLibraryManager = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<Video>>();

            // Create a test Video with an OwnerId
            _video = new Video
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                OwnerId = Guid.NewGuid()
            };

            // Inject the mocked logger using reflection since it's not virtual
            typeof(Video).GetProperty("Logger")?
                .SetValue(_video, _mockLogger.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo_LogsInformation_WhenOrphanedVideoFoundAndFileDoesNotExist()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/nonexistent/video.mp4";
            var orphanedVideoId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var orphanedVideo = new Video
            {
                Id = orphanedVideoId,
                OwnerId = _video.OwnerId
            };

            _mockLibraryManager
                .Setup(m => m.GetNewItemId(path, It.IsAny<Type>()))
                .Returns(orphanedVideoId);

            _mockLibraryManager
                .SetupSequence(m => m.GetItemById(It.IsAny<Guid>()))
                .Returns((BaseItem)null) // First call for file existence check
                .Returns(orphanedVideo); // Second call finds orphaned video

            // Act
            var options = new MetadataRefreshOptions();
            var cancellationToken = CancellationToken.None;
            await _video.RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo(options, false, path, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(s => s.ToString().Contains("Owned video file no longer exists, removing orphaned item:") && s.ToString().Contains(path)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo_DoesNotLog_WhenNoOrphanedVideoFound()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/nonexistent/video.mp4";

            _mockLibraryManager
                .Setup(m => m.GetNewItemId(path, It.IsAny<Type>()))
                .Returns(Guid.NewGuid());

            _mockLibraryManager
                .SetupSequence(m => m.GetItemById(It.IsAny<Guid>()))
                .Returns((BaseItem)null) // File existence check
                .Returns((BaseItem)null); // No orphaned video

            // Act
            var options = new MetadataRefreshOptions();
            var cancellationToken = CancellationToken.None;
            await _video.RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo(options, false, path, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
